Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract and for your feedback. I appreciate you bringing these points up so we can ensure the terms work well for both of us.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for a net-30 structure. While our standard policy is net-60, I am open to discussing this further to see if we can reach a middle ground that accommodates your workflow.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it is important for the terms to be equitable. Let’s schedule a brief call to discuss potential adjustments that would make the clause more reasonable while still protecting our mutual interests.

Please let me know what time works best for you to connect.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
